LanguageData.PhobosDosing_SettingEnabled: Doctors give medication on their own
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_SettingEnabledDesc: A patient who is down or in bed and in severe pain gets the best painkiller within reach; in extreme pain, a sedative when no medical painkiller can be given. A patient who is bleeding hard waits for a painkiller until that is under control. Off, doctors give none of this without your order.
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_SettingMinimumCare: Dose patients whose medical care is at least
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_SettingMinimumCareDesc: Only patients whose medical care setting is this level or better are dosed. "No medicine" and "no medical care" are never dosed.
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_SettingRecreationalDesc: Off by default: only medical drugs are given. On, social and hard drugs that relieve pain may be given as a last resort, when no medical painkiller or sedative can be.
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_SettingIgnoreAversion: Give medical drugs to patients who refuse drugs
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_SettingIgnoreAversionDesc: Off by default: a patient who would not take drugs (a teetotaler, or by belief) is not dosed. On, medical drugs are given anyway; recreational ones never.
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_SettingImmunity: Doctors give drugs that help fight disease
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_SettingImmunityDesc: A patient in bed with a disease that could kill them, and that is winning the race against their immunity, gets a medical drug that speeds their immunity up. Only doctors give these, and a patient who is winning the race gets none, so your stock lasts.
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_SettingFussing: Patients in extreme pain are harder to tend
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_SettingFussingDesc: On, someone awake and in extreme pain flinches and pulls away while being tended, so the tend comes out 10% worse, and up to a quarter worse at the very worst pain. Pain relief, which doctors give from 40% pain, keeps patients below it; someone asleep or under anaesthetic doesn't fuss.
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_SettingSelfMedication: People in pain fetch their own painkillers
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_SettingSelfMedicationDesc: A colonist who is up and about and in serious pain goes and takes the best painkiller their drug policy allows, for joy or on a schedule. Chemical interest and fascination make them reach for it sooner and ignore the policy, as they do for joy. Teetotalers never do. Addiction and overdose are real risks: choose your drug policies with this in mind.
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_SettingSlavesSelfMedicate: Slaves may take painkillers from your stock
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_SettingSlavesSelfMedicateDe: Off by default: slaves in pain wait for a doctor. On, a slave who is up and about and in serious pain does the same as a colonist, by their own drug policy. A slave who is rebelling or escaping never does. Doctors treat slaves in bed either way.
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_SettingGuestsSelfMedicate: Guests may take painkillers from your stock
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_SettingGuestsSelfMedicateDe: Off by default. On, guests in serious pain do the same, from whatever is within their reach. Guests have no drug policy, so they take medical painkillers only, never recreational ones. Useful with mods that bring many guests, such as Hospitality.
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_ModeDoctorsAndSelf: Doctors, and people take their own
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_SettingCureMode: Who gives a cure that is in stock
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_SettingCureModeDesc: A cure is anything that removes a condition outright, such as an antiserum for plague. With doctors, a patient who is down or in bed with a condition something in your stock cures is given it, the gentlest one first. A rare item, worth 300 silver or more, is used only against a condition that can kill. With nobody, cures wait for your own order.
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_SettingPreventionMode: Who gives a preventive when a disease strikes
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_SettingPreventionModeDesc: When someone in the colony has a disease that strikes groups, such as plague, malaria or the flu, the others can be protected with whatever in stock makes a person immune to it. Doctors give it to people who are down or in bed. With the last choice, people on their feet also go and take their own; a drug policy decides only for something addictive or taken for pleasure, because it has no tick for a plain medicine. Nothing addictive is ever used for this. In the game by itself diseases do not pass from person to person, so this protects against the next time it strikes, not this one.
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_SettingPreventionReserveDes: Prevention never takes a preventive below this many, counted for each kind, so an outbreak cannot empty the shelf. Treating someone who is already sick or hurt may always use the last one.
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_SettingUnmetAlert: Alert when nothing in stock answers a need
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_SettingUnmetAlertDesc: On, an alert at the side of the screen names anyone in severe pain, losing to a disease, with a curable condition or needing a radiation medicine while none of what would help is in stock. It speaks only of things your colony knows how to make, and goes away when the need is met or ends.
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_RefusalSedativeNotWanted: only a sedative ({DRUG}) is in reach, and the pain is not that bad
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_RefusalRecreationalOff: only a recreational drug ({DRUG}) is in reach, and doctors here will not give it for pain
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_RefusalCare: the patient's medical care level does not allow it
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_RefusalMentalState: the patient is in an aggressive mental state
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_RefusalStillActive: an earlier dose is still working
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_RefusalDangerousDose: another dose of {DRUG} would be dangerous
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_RefusalConsciousness: {DRUG} would leave the patient too close to unconsciousness
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_RefusalBleedingHold: {DRUG} must wait until the bleeding is under control
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_RefusalBreathing: {DRUG} would leave the patient unable to breathe
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_RefusalLethalDependency: {DRUG} would begin a dependency that kills when it stops
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_RefusalAddictiveForMinorNee: {DRUG} is addictive, and this is not serious enough for it
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_RefusalRareItemKept: {DRUG} is rare, and kept for saving a life
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_RefusalReserveKept: the last of the {DRUG} is being kept in reserve
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_UnmetIntro: These people need something your colony knows how to make, and none of it is in stock:
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_UnmetPain: in severe pain, with no painkiller in stock
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_UnmetDisease: losing to a disease, with nothing in stock that helps the body fight it
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_UnmetMedicine: needs {MEDICINE}, and none is in stock
